description: Kill switch: stop every send from an inbox at once (send, reply, drafts, SMTP and identity tokens all answer 423 inbox_paused) until resume_inbox. Mail sent to the inbox is still received and stored; its webhooks and events are held until resume. Use it when an agent is misbehaving (a reply loop, wrong recipients). Pausing a paused inbox changes nothing.

inbox_id.description: Inbox id (from create_inbox or list_inboxes), not the email address.

reason.description: Why, shown on the inbox and in the inbox.paused event.

name: pause_inbox
title: Pause inbox
